## 2. Put them in order

Number the events from 1 (first) to 5 (last).

☐ Augustus becomes the first emperor\
☐ Rome becomes a republic\
☐ The western empire falls\
☐ Julius Caesar is killed\
☐ The Colosseum is finished

## 3. {{< vocab "explain" text="Explain" zh=true >}} the change

{{< vocab "explain" text="Explain" zh=true >}} why some Romans wanted to keep the {{< vocab "republic" zh=true >}}, even when an {{< vocab "emperor" zh=true >}} brought peace.

*Some Romans wanted to keep the republic because …*

{{< lines 4 >}}

::: {.content-visible when-profile="teacher"}
{{< pagebreak >}}

::: {.callout-note title="Answer key"}
**1.** Republic: A, C, E, G, I. Empire: B, D, F, H, J.

**2.** 1 Rome becomes a republic (509 BC); 2 Julius Caesar is killed (44 BC); 3 Augustus becomes the first emperor (27 BC); 4 the Colosseum is finished (AD 80); 5 the western empire falls (AD 476).

**3.** Any reasoned answer: citizens lost their vote over leaders; one person held all the power; an emperor could be cruel or weak, and no one could replace him for a year.
:::
:::
